headline: Malawians still crippled by forex shortages as banks refuse to budge | Nyasa Times
summary: Travellers and businesses in Malawi continue to complain of severe foreign exchange shortages. Banks are accused of being unwilling to release forex.
why: Foreign exchange shortages disrupt imports, trade and business planning, and signal stress in an economy's currency and banking system.
